name: BlogRank
pitch: Pay to rank content; visitors watch/read, answer a question, and earn rewards for verified attention.
mvp: Link submission, paid rank, visit timer, quiz verification, wallet/UPI payout queue.

name: MatrimonyWall
pitch: Profiles, matchmakers and wedding services bid for the top slot in their city/community.
mvp: City/community filters, verified profiles, INR bids, moderation queue.

name: TalentStage
pitch: Singers, dancers and actors bid to rank their act; video link is the entry.
mvp: Video links, weekly stage slot, fan-share pages, applause clicks.

name: RankMyDish / FoodRank Delhi
pitch: Restaurants and street-food sellers bid to rank a dish in their city; coupon twist can fund visitors.
mvp: City board, dish photo, restaurant link, coupon pool, UPI/INR bids.

name: ShelfRank
pitch: Books and indie authors pay to rank above others in their genre.
mvp: Genre boards, cover upload, store links, weekly featured book.

name: GigWall
pitch: Freelancers bid to rank their portfolio in public client-facing walls.
mvp: Skill categories, portfolio links, client inquiry links, paid boosts.

name: FitLadder
pitch: Gyms, trainers and coaches bid to rank in their city using transformation entries.
mvp: City coach pages, image entries, booking links, weekly top coach badge.

name: MemeStand
pitch: Meme creators pay to pin image memes on a daily ranked wall.
mvp: Daily reset, image upload, frozen archive, share cards.

name: CampusClash
pitch: Universities ranked by student bids; campus pride becomes the product.
mvp: Campus pages, student email verification, aggregate bids, weekly crown.

name: ChairRank
pitch: Barbers, salons and stylists bid to hold the top chair in their city.
mvp: City walls, fresh-cut photos, booking links, rank badges.

name: VowWall
pitch: Wedding vendors rank by bid across photographers, venues, planners, DJs and caterers.
mvp: Vendor categories, city walls, portfolio photos, inquiry CTA.

name: PourRank
pitch: Coffee shops, bars and breweries bid to become the top pour in town.
mvp: Venue entries, drink photos, city pages, printable top-pour badge.

name: NightBoard
pitch: DJs, promoters and clubs bid to top tonight’s nightlife wall.
mvp: Daily rounds, event flyers, city/date filters, ticket links.

name: The Last Word
pitch: One text box; each higher bid resets a timer; final holder wins the pot.
mvp: One message, countdown, pot split, notifications, final archive.

name: NameBid
pitch: A website auctions its own name every week to the highest bidder.
mvp: Weekly auction, theme swap, named-by credit, archive.

name: GhostWall
pitch: Anonymous leaderboard where identity is revealed only by paying extra.
mvp: Anonymous messages, paid unmask, moderation, no-link default.

name: DebatePot
pitch: Two options, one pot; people pay to back a side and winners split the pot.
mvp: Duel creation, paid sides, close timer, pro-rata settlement.

name: TimeCapsule Rank
pitch: Pay to lock a message for a future date; deeper dates rank higher.
mvp: Message lock, future date, countdown, public unlock archive.

name: ShipOrSkip
pitch: Makers pitch ideas; the crowd pays to vote SHIP or SKIP.
mvp: Pitch cards, paid votes, shipped wall, owner updates.

name: AttentionDividend
pitch: Split part of each bid with visitors who actually viewed entries.
mvp: View tracking, reward ledger, anti-fraud checks, payout threshold.

name: CashbackClick
pitch: Every real click gets instant micro-cashback from the bid pool.
mvp: Click validation, UPI payouts, click pool, fraud limits.

name: ShieldBid
pitch: Buy rank insurance; first outbid attempt bounces unless attacker pays more.
mvp: Shield purchase, block event, attacker notice, single-use expiry.

name: SeasonPass
pitch: Monthly rank wipes with passes, badges, streaks and a season prize.
mvp: Season reset, pass purchase, streak badges, final pot.

name: PredictWall
pitch: Visitors predict who holds #1 at close; correct predictors split a pot.
mvp: Prediction entries, close time, winner calculation, payout ledger.
